Exemplar Devices Inc. Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results

SPRINGFIELD, OHIO — Exemplar Devices Inc. today announced results for its third quarter of fiscal 2026, ended June 27, 2026.
Revenue$1.01 billion
Non-GAAP diluted EPS$1.12

Revenue was $1.01 billion, up 12 percent from the prior year, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $1.12.

Business Outlook

For the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company expects revenue of $1.05 billion to $1.10 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 61 percent, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.20 to $1.30.

For fiscal 2026, the Company now expects revenue of approximately $4.1 billion, up from its prior outlook of approximately $4.0 billion, and continues to expect capital expenditures of approximately $150 million.

The Company anticipates that demand for its inspection products remains strong.

This press release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, including statements about revenue, gross margin and earnings per share that we expect for future periods.
